name: Ninefold wreck
description: A consortium survey tender, NINEFOLD stenciled on her flank, tumbling slowly in the red light. Her hatches are welded shut. From the inside.

name: Quiet point
description: A patch of space between the twin suns where Okafor says the Oort signal comes through clearest.

name: White dwarf shadow
description: In the lee of Sirius B, shielded from the big star's glare. Quiet enough to hear something very far away.

name: The beacon
description: Out past every planet, past the comets, in the dark. Something vast and very old, waiting.
